title: Longest rising run
prompt: Implement `int longestRisingRun(int[] arr)`: the length of the longest stretch of strictly increasing adjacent values. {3, 1, 2, 3, 0, 5} → 3. This is adjacency scanning + an accumulator + a seeded best — compose them; run the empty and single probes first.

tests.name: longest run found
tests.hint: current run starts at 1; extend while arr[i] > arr[i-1]; reset to 1 otherwise; track best.
